claims.text: Grand Hyatt Barcelona is in the Pedralbes district of Barcelona.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Barcelona sits at the heart of Pedralbes, one of the city's most exclusive and sought-after districts
findings.note: The official page places the hotel in Pedralbes.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from Spotify Camp Nou, home of FC Barcelona.

findings.quote: Football fans will find themselves just steps from Spotify Camp Nou, home of FC Barcelona

claims.text: The Monastery of Pedralbes, the Real Club de Tennis Barcelona and Les Corts Market are just steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Just steps from the hotel, the Monastery of Pedralbes, the Real Club de Tennis Barcelona and the local stalls of Les Corts Market reveal a quieter, residential side of the city
findings.note: Names all three places as steps from the hotel.

claims.text: Each room has custom-made furniture, a separate rain shower and WC, and Natura Bissé bathroom amenities.

findings.quote: Custom-made furniture, a separate rain shower and WC and Natura Bissé bathroom amenities complete each room

claims.text: The Junior Suite bathroom is finished in custom tilework and marble, with a deep-soaking bathtub and a walk-in shower.

findings.quote: along with a bathroom finished in custom tilework and marble, with dual sinks, a striking deep-soaking bathtub and a walk-in shower
findings.note: From the 1 King Bed Junior Suite description.

claims.text: The Premium King Room with View has direct views of the city and the sea.

findings.quote: This room offers direct views of the city and the sea, along with a king bed, a work desk, a sitting area and a bathroom with dual sinks and a separate walk-in shower.
findings.note: From the 1 King Premium with View description.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the 18th floor serves an American breakfast buffet, snacks during the day and a tapas time in the evening.

findings.quote: From a delicious American Breakfast Buffet to Snacks during the day and a dedicated Tapas Time in the evening
The Grand Club Lounge is located on the 18th Floor.

claims.text: Oasis Wellness & Spa by Natura Bissé has a thermal water circuit, a sauna, a steam bath, and salt and ice cabins.

findings.quote: Oasis Wellness & Spa by Natura Bissé is a Mediterranean sanctuary of contrasts with a thermal water circuit, sauna, steam bath, salt and ice cabins
findings.note: Lists all the facilities in the claim.

claims.text: Maymanta is a Peruvian restaurant on the 19th-floor rooftop, curated by chef Omar Malpartida.

findings.quote: Perched on the 19th-floor rooftop, Maymanta Barcelona brings the bold, authentic flavors of Peru to life with a modern twist, curated by chef Omar Malpartida
findings.note: Covers the location, cuisine and chef.

claims.text: Leña is the first Dani García restaurant in Barcelona, cooking over embers.

findings.quote: The first and only Dani García restaurant in Barcelona, Leña reimagines the brasa experience with global flair. Here, exceptional ingredients meet the primal art of cooking over embers
findings.note: Covers both 'first' and the ember cooking.

claims.text: Complimentary children's and baby kits are available on request, including colouring sets, booster seats and cribs.

findings.quote: Complimentary children’s and baby kits available upon request, including colouring sets, booster seats, cribs, bathtubs, and tailored in-room amenities.

claims.text: Dogs are welcomed with an amenity kit that includes a pet bed, food and water bowls and treats.

findings.quote: Dogs are warmly welcomed with a curated amenity kit featuring a plush pet bed, food and water bowls, and gourmet treats
findings.note: Covers every item in the kit.

claims.text: The Penthouse Suite is a three-bedroom apartment with a show kitchen, a dining area for up to ten and views of the city, sea and mountains.

findings.quote: This three-bedroom apartment includes a master bedroom, a living room with a separate show kitchen and a dining area for up to ten, with sweeping views of the city, sea and surrounding mountains.

claims.text: The spa has six private cabins for Natura Bissé treatments, including a double suite with a private sauna, steam room and jacuzzi.

findings.quote: six private cabins for exclusive Natura Bissé treatments (including a double suite with a private sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi)
findings.note: From the Condé Nast Traveler review.

claims.text: From the 12th floor up, rooms have panoramas of Barcelona stretching down to the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: the 12th floor and up offering eye-popping panoramas of Barcelona stretching all the way down to the Mediterranean

claims.text: Suites have Art Deco-inspired design and are set on the hotel's higher floors with views of Barcelona.

findings.quote: the hotel's 50 suites range from 59 to 319 square meters, with Art Deco-inspired design
each is set on the hotel's higher floors with stunning views of Barcelona
findings.note: Covers the higher floors and views.

claims.text: The outdoor pool is set in a garden and is open from spring through autumn.

findings.quote: The outdoor pool at Grand Hyatt Barcelona unfolds within a lush, immersive garden setting, made for long, memorable afternoons with friends and family from spring through autumn.
findings.note: Covers both the garden setting and the season.

claims.text: Rooms on the lower floors are businesslike, with a gray and white palette and restricted views.

findings.quote: Lower floors are distinctly businesslike with their muted, gray and white color palette and restricted views.

claims.text: There are fewer tourist sites around the hotel than downtown; central Barcelona is about a 15-minute metro ride away.

findings.quote: While you’ll find fewer tourist sites around here, there is plenty to do
just a 15-minute metro ride from central Barcelona

claims.text: The hotel is next to the Catalan Congress Center and the university, and attracts groups and business travelers.

findings.quote: The plentiful rooms and setting next to the Catalan Congress Center and university attract groups and business execs
